sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Move nltl:similarAttachmentConstructionPresent off the transverse frame because its canonical domain is frameAttachment. Keep the frame as the target, require nltl:hasFrameAttachment ?attachment, and express the fitted-construction alternative on that attachment: either ?attachment nltl:hasConnectionBracket ?bracket or ?attachment nltl:similarAttachmentConstructionPresent true. Also replace the simple presence, boolean, integer, quantity datatype, and unit SPARQL constraints with SHACL Core constraints; retain only bounded SPARQL where shared attachment identity and the bracket-thickness >= frame-web-thickness comparison require cross-node comparison.
